items.title: Unify theme tokens and enforce visual conformance
items.verification: Every built-in theme passes the versioned token, contrast, component-gallery, Axe, and required Electron conformance checks documented in THEME_DESIGN_BRIEF.md.

items.title: Fit complete presentation slides inside the viewport
items.verification: At the minimum supported window and in Present mode, every edge of a 16:9 slide is visible without internal slide scrolling or adjacent-slide overlap.

items.title: Make file opening and preview rendering latest-wins
items.verification: A rapid A-B-A file-switch test with delayed settings and markdown rendering always leaves the editor, preview, tab, status, and current path on the final A request.

items.title: Keep presenter navigation stable after live deck reload
items.verification: After a live content reload in delivery mode, Next and Previous remain enabled for the committed slide and no delayed reconciliation can reset presenter state.

items.title: Unify commands, menus, shortcuts, and feature actions
items.verification: Unit contracts keep portable macOS/Windows shortcuts conflict-free, repository checks reject legacy registrations and hard-coded native accelerators, and the required @actions Electron workflow discovers and executes a bundled feature action.

items.title: Integrate PDF annotations with citations and research notes
items.verification: Packaged and development builds can highlight PDF text, persist page-addressed annotations, link them to a citation, and create a source-linked Markdown note without falling back to no-op annotation behavior.

items.title: Expand structured records into a labelling and review workbench
items.verification: A schema-backed JSONL or CSV task supports keyboard-first labelling, saved filters, bulk operations, resumable progress, and reviewer disagreement or adjudication while preserving the source format.

items.title: Replace stale browser-style E2E tests with reliable Electron workflows
items.verification: The default E2E command runs a small deterministic Electron matrix on macOS and CI, reports real executions versus skips, and covers editor-preview and full-slide geometry.

items.title: Add safe workspace publishing profiles for multi-repository sites
items.verification: Hermetic service, IPC, renderer, security, stale-plan, and staged-index tests cover discovery through confirmed execution; required Electron CI opens the real workflow through the shared action registry.

items.title: Keep tutor-core runtime data outside app.asar
items.verification: A clean packaged launch initializes tutor-core using only app userData paths and emits no app.asar write or ENOTDIR error.

items.title: Add presentation authoring preflight and presenter tools
items.verification: A presentation preflight reports overflow, missing assets, and basic accessibility failures for every slide, while the presenter view exposes current, next, notes, and timer state without clipping the delivered slide.

items.title: Make presentation loading fail visibly and recoverably
items.verification: Injected feature-loader, React-render, and content-parse failures each show an actionable error and Retry returns to a rendered deck without restarting NightOwl.

items.title: Add a repository-owned local CI gate
items.verification: npm run ci:local passes from this linked worktree, reports capability skips explicitly, and npm run ci:local:release validates packaging inputs.

items.title: Restore tracked macOS entitlements and clean-build preflight
items.verification: Distribution preflight, ARM64 assembly, and all 3 packaged Electron checks pass; hosted required-smoke also builds and exercises the packaged app.

items.title: Make AI document edits reviewable and attributable
items.verification: An AI editing action presents a deterministic proposed diff with disclosed context and provider provenance, and applies only explicitly accepted hunks through Monaco's undoable edit path.

items.title: Sanitize rendered Markdown and restrict external navigation
items.verification: A malicious Markdown fixture cannot execute handlers, load disallowed iframe origins, or open a non-allowlisted URI scheme in development or packaged builds.

items.title: Use one state model for modes and pane visibility
items.verification: Reducer and Electron tests prove that mode, pane, fullscreen, source, zen, and structured-record transitions preserve one live state; local CI passed 90 suites/1,181 tests plus 6/6 source and 3/3 packaged Electron checks.

items.title: Build one multi-format workspace index
items.verification: Quick Open, workspace search, links, rename planning, and graph consumers query one incremental index that covers every supported text and structured-record format without stale results after a file change.

items.title: Add accessible names and preserve presentation semantics
items.verification: Axe and keyboard tests pass for editor and presentation controls, and every visible icon-only control has a stable accessible name.

items.title: Add capability health and focused workflow presets
items.verification: NightOwl reports available, degraded, and missing capabilities with actionable checks, and Writing, Research, Presentation, and Labelling presets project a focused reversible UI without hiding user data or disabling required actions.

items.title: Make presentation source, build output, and CSS ownership explicit
items.verification: The root presentation build/check deterministically reproduces MarkdownPreziApp.js; local CI passed 6/6 stages, 92 suites / 1,193 tests, and 7 required Electron workflows; a fresh ARM64 package passed 3/3 packaged workflows and ASAR inspection contained only canonical plugin assets.

items.title: Decompose renderer.js around workflow coordinators
items.verification: File opening, preview routing, file-tree orchestration, and pane transitions now use dependency-injected controllers. Local CI passed 91 suites / 1,188 tests and 7 required Electron workflows; a fresh ARM64 package passed all 3 packaged workflows.

items.title: Make unit and integration tests portable across worktrees
items.verification: A fresh worktree with the documented dependency setup runs all unit and integration projects without hard-coded node_modules paths, port-policy failures, or leaked file watchers.

items.title: Minimize Electron preload and remote privilege surface
items.verification: NightOwl runs with no unused @electron/remote enablement, a smaller typed preload API, sender validation for privileged IPC, and an explicit documented reason for every sandbox exception.

items.title: Add budgets for startup, file switching, preview, and large documents
items.verification: CI or a documented benchmark job records p50 and p95 startup, file-switch, preview-ready, and presentation-ready timings against fixed small and large fixtures with regression thresholds.

items.title: Refresh architecture, ownership, and build documentation
items.verification: Architecture and contributor docs match the current NightOwl directories, IPC names, feature loader, generated assets, workplan flow, and clean build procedure.

items.title: Provide structured diagnostics and recoverable view errors
items.verification: A user can copy a redacted diagnostic report for a failed view and retry or reset that view without restarting the app.

items.title: Give timers, listeners, observers, and watchers explicit owners
items.verification: Repeated feature and mode cycles returned to the live timer/listener/observer/watcher baseline; local release CI passed 7/7 stages, 94 suites / 1,200 tests, and 8 required Electron workflows; a fresh ARM64 package passed 3/3 packaged workflows.

items.title: Make structured record editing schema-driven
items.verification: A workspace can attach a declarative schema to JSONL or CSV files and receive typed controls, required-field validation, completion progress, and export validation without changing NightOwl source.

items.title: Turn static export into a validated publishing workflow
items.verification: Static publication uses the same trusted Markdown semantics as preview, rewrites internal links and assets deterministically, provides a local site preview, and passes a no-network publication contract test.

items.title: Replace or retire the prototype collaboration surface
items.verification: The collaboration surface is either backed by tested convergent document synchronization, reconnect and identity semantics, or is removed from normal product discovery and explicitly labelled unsupported.
